description: Contract cases for api/launcher-v1.openrpc.json beyond the examples there: every errorCode of every method, the caller-check order and edge cases. Same meaning as an example pairing with x-fixture (see x-fixtureFormat in the spec), shorter: params is an object, result is the reply, a fixture is merged over defaults, and a call given as a string is the named entry of parts. paramsOutsideSchema marks a success case that sends params the schema does not allow, to pin what the service does with them.
